title: Lilly Pulitzer, Janie and Jack Team for Limited-edition Collaboration
text:
The limited-edition collaboration blends Lilly Pulitzer's iconic Palm Beach prints with Janie and Jack's polished silhouettes for men, women, children and babies.
Palm Beach spirit with Janie and Jack’s refined approach to childrenswear, creating coordinated looks for babies, girls, boys, and matching styles for women and men.
The collaboration features four prints, designed to span generations. Three prints in the children’s collection are offered in coordinating looks for women and men, while a fourth — On Parade — is an exclusive childrenswear pattern, recolored from a previous Pulitzer release. At the heart of the collection is Ship to Shore, an archival Lilly Pulitzer print, reimagined for a fresh take on the brand’s coast-inspired storytelling.
“We’re seeing strong demand for coordinated family dressing that still feels elevated,” Lexi Tawes, chief product officer at Janie and Jack, told WWD. “This collection brings Lilly’s signature joy and color together with Janie and Jack’s timeless silhouettes and thoughtful design details to create pieces that feel polished, modern, and made for summer months. ” She added, “At Janie and Jack, our focus is on creating pieces that become part of a family’s story.
Bringing Lilly Pulitzer’s iconic, joy-filled prints into our world allows us to reimagine that heritage through the lens of childhood — blending nostalgia, emotion and modern family life in a way that feels both timeless and new. ”Mira Fain, chief creative officer of Lilly Pulitzer, said, “For this capsule, we drew inspiration from the rituals of summer — from seaside mornings to celebratory evenings — designing each piece to transition seamlessly through those moments.
The silhouettes feel elevated yet effortless, allowing the prints to shine while offering versatility for the whole family. The collection is ideal for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, and family gatherings throughout the summer.
“We approached the collection with a strong focus on craftsmanship and cohesion, ensuring every print and silhouette works harmoniously across categories,” Fain added. “The collection celebrates the joy of dressing every generation — babies, boys, girls, men and women can all fall in Lilly this summer. Each piece stands on its own while coming together to tell a broader story of color, optimism and modern heritage dressing across all life stages.
”Priced from $24 to $99, the Lilly Pulitzer x Janie and Jack collection will be available on lillypulitzer.com, Janieandjack.com, in company-owned retail locations across both brands nationwide, and in select wholesale accounts.
